Great-Gammer '''Lissar''' was the matriarch of a [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaalian]] family and the founder of its mercantile success. [[Darrik]], who stowed away on [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe's]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], was a member of her family.<ref name="IDC" />
